notes: Called from populate paths in serverreplay.c and seedworld.c, so it runs in the tick when a chunk populates. The tree, lake, spring and plant features live in features*.c; this file only chooses and dispatches them. The bshape fields and the exact Java member names of the BiomeGen* choice helpers (func_150567_a trees, func_150572_a flowers) are cited from the code comments and MCP convention, not re-read in each Java file.
